name: web-dev
description: Web apps in a headless browser through playwright-cli: one skill that makes the model start a web app the way the project documents it, use it in a browser no one sees, and record a video of each feature working, a user-invoked skill that measures page load with chrome-devtools traces and Lighthouse, plus a mod that denies the playwright-cli, chrome-devtools, Lighthouse and xdg-open commands that would open a browser window on the user's screen, and the playwright-cli commands that close the browsers of other sessions.
